Inspiration (use analogy, not replication): TITLE: Two-guarantee scoring: conformal false-positive control plus isotonic-calibrated probabilities for MVFA
SUMMARY: Report two numbers per image from the same inductive pipeline: a conformal few-shot p-value that controls false positives on normals, and a probability obtained by passing the log-odds fusion of both branches through an isotonic map learned on source episodes.
HYPOTHESIS: On held-out modalities with K >= 4, thresholding the conformal p-value at 0.05 gives a realised false-positive rate within 2 points of 5%, while the isotonic-calibrated fused probability has ECE at least 50% lower than uncalibrated log-odds fusion; image AUROC of the fused score stays within 1 point of the transductive pipeline.
RATIONALE: The conformal parent gives a finite-sample false-positive guarantee but its fused log-odds score is calibrated only through parametric source weights; the isotonic parent calibrates monotonically without changing ranking but relies on CDF averages. Clinical deployment needs both a rule that bounds false alarms (a screening threshold) and a calibrated probability (for triage), and they need not come from the same quantity. Combining the parents assigns each guarantee to the component that can provide it: the few-shot conformal p-value for false-positive control and an isotonic map on the log-odds fused score for calibration.
METHOD: 1) Few-shot conformal p-value p as in the conformal parent (LOO support image scores). 2) Zero-shot probability p0 with source-fitted temperature. 3) Fused logit z = w0 logit(p0) + w1 logit(1 - p) + c (logistic weights on source episodes). 4) Isotonic map g fitted on source-episode (z, label) pairs; reported probability g(z). 5) Decision rules: screening = p <= 0.05; triage = g(z). 6) test_few.py: implement both outputs; remove test-set min-max. No adapter training.
EXPERIMENT: Leave-one-modality-out on BMAD (RESC and OCT17 held out together), MVFA retrained with source-validation selection; K in {2,4,8,16}; 3 seeds x 3 support draws. Baselines: transductive MVFA pipeline, support z-score. Ordered ablation: (i) conformal p only, (ii) + log-odds fusion, (iii) + isotonic calibration. Metrics: realised FPR at p <= 0.05, ECE and Brier of g(z), image AUROC, score shift under resampling. Falsified if realised FPR exceeds 7% or ECE is not halved relative to uncalibrated fusion.
